lines.text: Jesus passes between Samaria and Galilee on His way to Jerusalem and is met by ten lepers.
The lepers shout for mercy, and Jesus tells them to show themselves to the priests.
While on their way to the priests, all ten are cleansed, and one comes back, praising Moses.
The man who returns falls facedown at Jesus' feet in thanksgiving, and he is a Galilean.
Jesus asks where the other nine are and tells the man that his faith has made him well.
